_one_table_for_every_long_job: It lived under ledger/ until a second caller appeared. Lifting it then is this repo's rule about templates - earlier and the layer has one consumer, later and the second caller writes its own copy. A unit is a page for the ledger and a chunk for ingestion; the table does not need to know which.
_why_this_is_a_file_and_not_constants: The brief's S1 (2026-08-31): the chain's own pacing numbers (OUTBOX_PURGE_CHUNK, OUTBOX_PURGE_MAX_CHUNKS, SWEEP_INTERVAL) are hardcoded in chain_ingestion_worker.py, and the order was to copy the SHAPE without copying that. An operator who needs a backfill to stop crowding the database at 2am cannot edit a constant and restart the server - that is the very restart this round exists to remove.
_default_is_todays_behaviour: S3: `fast` must be exactly what the backfill did before this existed - no cap, no rest - because changing the default is a different decision and it belongs to the owner. Slowing down is something an operator CHOOSES per run.
_the_shape_is_the_chain_s: units_per_cycle is the chain's max_chunks; rest_seconds is what it gets instead of the chain's sweep interval, because a backfill runs to completion inside one call rather than waking on a timer. Both are per RUN, chosen by whoever starts it.
_a_job_that_nobody_starts_by_hand_names_: A backfill takes its pace from whoever pressed the button. A job that runs by itself has nobody to ask, so the answer is declared - one cell, no restart. The ledger follow-up starts on the SLOWEST declared pace on purpose: it is work nobody is waiting for, and the chain that feeds it is.

fast.label: Fast - as before
fast.when: When it is urgent: the service is quiet, or the next step waits for this one

slow.label: Slow - while in service
slow.when: When screens or the API slow down with it. Takes longer, crowds others less

trickle.label: Very slow - overnight
trickle.when: When staying out of the way matters more than when it finishes

background.label: Background - measuring, not finishing
background.when: Always-on work such as the census. A lap may be as slow as it likes; others must not slow down meanwhile

_ledger_row_census: S-58. The declaration screen shows 'table rows / indexed / not yet translated' per source, and both numbers are scans. D5 forbids a scan inside a request, so this job measures them on its own clock and the request reads what it stored.
